entities.name: Eugène Caillaux
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Eugène Alexandre Caillaux was a French engineer and politician. He was Minister of Public Works from 1874 until 1876, then Minister of Finance from May to November 1877. He was the father of the politician Joseph Caillaux.
